builds.hypothesis: Thrust5=(190+0.9 totalAD+0.65 AP)*(1+0.333*critChance) physical. AP competes with AD; crit feeds bespoke chance modifier, IE critDamage irrelevant. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee feed0.65 AP thrust; IE/LDR50% crit chance feeds native0.333 factor plusAD; LDR penetrates physical damage; Shojin AD/amplifier candidate. IE critDamage does not scale W.

kitEvidence.formula:
Xin Zhao slashes, dealing [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage, then thrusts, dealing [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.9) × AD + (0.65) × AP) × ((1 + (0.333) × Stat(8)))]. Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by [50]% for [1.5 + (0.005) × AP] seconds. 

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for [3] seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.
